source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Blood, Language, ViolenceGamesCRYMELIGHTReleases 11/4/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalSale ends: 11/4/26 at 02:59 p.m. UTCBlood, Language, ViolenceLoadingA roguelike action game where you face your sins. The greater your penance, the stronger you become."I'll make these sins mean something."Pure maidens shoulder sin for the sake of love; the more they repent, the stronger they grow.At the brink of resolve and madness lies a tale that will grip your heart.[Story]"You are all sinners."This is Wonderland, a prison for the souls of the dead.A girl bereft of her memories is granted the name "Alice" by her guide, the White Rabbit.She is led to the site of a tea party.There, Alice learns of a rule:In this game, only those who can defeat the Queen are granted freedom.And so, Alice joins forces with a mysterious girl called Mary and resolves to participate in the game to return to her world.Whenever she comes into contact with the sins of her companions, she is able to see the painful pasts they experienced....Why did the Queen create this world?And what awaits the victor? Salvation... or retribution?[Game System]A roguelike action game in which you venture out into Wonderland, ruled by the Queen, while battling to the death against her forces.An innocent girl who wields sin to fight in the land of the dead.Wonder DimensionThe moment an enemy is slain, an indigo "Wonder Dimension" will spread across the field.As the dimension expands, your abilities will grow stronger and the action will speed up.Your acquired skills determine how quickly the dimension expands and the way in which your abilities are enhanced, changing the way you approach battles.Poker SystemCollect 5 skill cards to form poker-style hands.Stronger combinations result in stronger effects, changing the course of the battle with different attacks and tactics.What cards do you hold onto? What hands will you aim for? Your choices will determine victory or defeat.Repentance SystemConfess the sins you have shouldered in your death battles and transform them into power.Alice will take on the sins of the wayward souls she defeats along the way.The tears of penitence will become power-up items for you to use.Powering UpUse the materials you obtain through repentance to make your weapons and accessories more powerful.Even if you are thrown back in time and lose your cards, you can keep some progress through this.Next time, aim to go deeper; go farther.Tea PartiesA place where all participants gather, mingle, and prepare themselves for the next battle.The girls may touch on various things such as their pasts and may even divulge surprising details about slain foes.[Creators]Story written by Naoki Hisaya. Music by Sakuzyo. Character design by YOGISYA.[Cast]Alice: Sayaka SenbongiMary: Hitomi SekineCheshire: Yukina ShutoMad: Nao OjikaMarch: Yurina AmamiWhite Rabbit: Yu SasaharaSoftware description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):【Pre-order Bonus】 - CRYMELIGHT - Red Pouch*Pre-order bonus is available for customers who purchase by 23:59 (JST) on November 4, 2026.*Pre-order bonuses may be distributed at a later date.About this itemGame file size (estimated)5.9 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Learn moreSystemNintendo Switch 2PublisherFURYU CorporationSupported languagesJapanese, American EnglishRelease dateNovember 4, 2026ESRB ratingBlood, Language, ViolenceWARNING: If you have epilepsy or have had seizures or other unusual reactions to flashing lights or patterns, consult a doctor before playing video games. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.It's possible that information related to the game, including ratings and download size, may not be finalized at time of preorder.

source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 10Animated Blood, Fantasy ViolenceGamesThe Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of TimeReleases 11/5/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - The Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of TimeAnimated Blood, Fantasy ViolenceLoadingTake up your sword and embark on a grand adventure!Gameplay of the trailer for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time begins as glowing fireflies hover gently across the screen.Play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time trailer.A classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.Watch the trailerWatch the trailerThe battle for Hyrule beginsThe evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the Hero of Time and save the kingdom in the Legend of Zelda™: Ocarina of Time game, exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2.Link is the only member of the Kokiri who doesn't have a fairy, until the Great Deku Tree asks Navi to accompany him in his adventures. Fairies often have helpful hints to share—if you see any on this page, be sure to see what they have to say!LinkThe young hero of the story, accompanied by his trusty fairy, Navi. ZeldaThe young princess of Hyrule seeking to protect her kingdom.GanondorfThe menacing leader of the Gerudo, who harbors ambitions to seize the Triforce.LinkZeldaGanondorfPrevious gallery itemNext gallery itemActive gallery item: 1 of 3.Hear Navi's VoiceThe legend reborn for a new generationEnjoy completely overhauled visuals, orchestral music, voice acting, and expanded cutscenes. Jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this a great entry point into this legendary series.Unlock the power of the ocarinaLink’s ocarina may appear to be an ordinary musical instrument, but if played correctly, can wield incredible magical powers.Play Video.Play Video.Previous gallery itemNext gallery itemActive gallery item: 1 of 2.Play Video.You can play Link’s Fairy Ocarina or the Ocarina of Time with traditional button controls or try humming, or even playing your own instruments into the Nintendo Switch 2 microphone! The songs Link learns to play on his ocarina have all kinds of effects, like opening new paths, changing day to night, and more.Lore and moreLearn a little more about the story and local lore with these new features!Previous gallery itemNext gallery itemItem 1 of 4.Listen to new and expanded dialog from characters big and small.A series of gameplay moments scrolls across the screen from right to left. Help Link become the Hero of TimeDuring his epic journey to save the kingdom, our young hero becomes much more powerful—and so does his equipment!Gameplay of a young Link using his strength to pull up the Master Sword before transforming into adult Link. autoplay video descriptionYoung LinkHe may be small, but young Link’s kid-sized weapons help him take on foes twice his size.Adult LinkAs Link grows older, he gains the ability to wield the legendary Master Sword, along with other useful tools to help him on his quest. Young LinkAdult LinkKokiri SwordDeku ShieldFairy SlingshotDeku StickKokiri SwordThis small, child-sized sword is a treasure of Kokiri Forest.Item 1 of 4.Ranged weapons like the Fairy Bow and the Hookshot can be aimed through button controls or through motion controls. You can customize that in the Options menu.Explore the kingdom of HyruleWhether you’re a first-time visitor or a seasoned adventurer, you’ll want to explore every corner of this fabled land—you never know who you might meet!Lon Lon RanchHyrule CastleKokiri ForestZora’s RiverGoron CityKakariko VillageLon Lon RanchHyrule CastleKokiri ForestZora’s RiverGoron CityKakariko VillageLon Lon RanchLon Lon RanchThe cows at this farm are famous for their rejuvenating milk, but the ranch’s prized horses are the real reason to visit. Hyrule CastleHyrule CastleThis majestic palace is home to the royal family, including Princess Zelda. The castle is only accessible by official invitation (unless you can find another way in). Just south of the stronghold lies Hyrule Castle Town, a lively village full of shops and friendly locals.Kokiri ForestKokiri ForestThe green and woodsy home of Link and the peaceful Kokiri, childlike folk who never grow old, along with their trusty fairies. They live in the shade of the Great Deku Tree, their wise and ancient guardian.Zora’s RiverZora’s RiverFollow Zora’s River to the waterfall and play a specific tune on your ocarina to gain entrance to the enchanting land of the Zora—the proud, fishlike folk who rule the waters of Hyrule.Goron CityGoron CityJust up the hill from Kakariko Village (right below fiery Death Mountain) is Goron City, home of the hard-working, rock-eating Gorons.Kakariko VillageKakariko VillageOn the way to the Death Mountain Trail lies the small town of Kakariko Village, home to many colorful characters.
